sources.title: Prahaladha/hima-tts-nano-hi-mlx-fp16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: hima-tts-nano-hi (Hindi text to speech, 62M parameters) converted to MLX (float16), for fast speech on the GPU of a Mac with Apple silicon. Same voices, same sound; no PyTorch needed. There is also an 8-bit version.

sources.title: Prahaladha/hima-tts-nano-hi · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: hima-tts-nano-hi Hindi text to speech in a small model (62M parameters). It runs on a laptop CPU, faster than real time, and there are ONNX and MLX versions for even faster local use.
